chapters.title: Connection to Israel

summary: This class discusses personal connections to Israel as the homeland for the Jewish people. Speakers express how the land connects them to their heritage, ancestors, and Avraham Avinu.
questions: Why is Israel important to the Jewish people?
How does the speaker connect to Israel?
What is the connection to Avraham Avinu?
